requirements.text: Parse exactly four decimal octets and prefix length 0..32, normalizing network host bits.
Return the minimum original rule ordinal among all matching prefixes.
Publish complete immutable rule versions; malformed updates cannot partially replace active policy.

problem.scope: Authored implementation study of ordered ALLOW/DENY IPv4 CIDR rules. First match in original rule order wins; this is deliberately different from longest-prefix routing. Invalid input fails closed; no matching rule defaults to DENY. IPv6, packet transport and stateful firewall connection tracking are out of scope.
problem.studyLabel: Ordered IPv4 firewall: scan and priority trie

stages.explanation: Build and validate the replacement rule array before exposing it to readers. Publish the array and its version together with one atomic reference swap. Each reader captures that pair once and uses it for the entire scan, so an update cannot mix old rules with a new version label. Keep the previous array alive until its readers finish. This is [immutable publication](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Read-copy-update).
invariants: Policy ordinal and result version refer to the same snapshot.
